ideas.pitch: A high-frequency scenario practice platform built specifically for rapid-fire stock market simulations with real-time timers and instant scoring feedback.
ideas.title: AlphaSpeed Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since the hackathon features a rapid 2.5-minute decision simulation with tie-breaking based on response speed, building a tool that helps participants train their reaction times and algorithmic indicator-reading gives them a massive edge.

ideas.pitch: An LLM-driven financial indicator parser that instantly extracts sentiment and trend implications from raw company updates and market scenarios.
ideas.title: MacroFlash AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in a stock market simulation track value automated sentiment and risk analysis under tight pressure, mirroring the multi-agent orchestration pattern seen in winning AI market research tools.

ideas.pitch: A real-time portfolio risk calculation dashboard that computes volatility and downside metrics instantly during live market scenarios.
ideas.title: RiskMatrix Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on rigorous quantitative risk analysis, directly addressing the core competencies required to evaluate market fluctuations and make optimal 'Buy', 'Sell', or 'Hold' choices.

ideas.pitch: A response time and decision accuracy tracking suite that logs simulation decisions down to the millisecond to help teams audit and improve their trading strategies.
ideas.title: TradeLens Telemetry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ties directly into the event scoring mechanism where average response time breaks ties, giving competitive teams an analytical breakdown of their decision bottlenecks.

ideas.pitch: A custom financial scenario generator that creates dynamic market shocks and company update permutations for advanced trading practice.
ideas.title: ScenarioForge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep domain expertise in financial engineering by allowing teams to stress-test their trading instincts against black-swan event models.
